g.text: P = Pending implementation; all new connectors are pending.
Services are singletons; snapshots and sessions are per Run.
All Claw target services live in coding-agent-cli.
HTTP: runtimeapi; scheduling: schedule; tool adapter: tool.cron.
Mate APIs supply trusted bindings, authorization and credentials.
Configuration handlers never call prepare or start a Session.
A rule registers automatic work; no rule only saves.
Each Run creates a Session, not an Agent definition.
No catch-up or execution replay; busy occurrences are skipped.
ASK ends the root; no durable interaction wait.
Unknown execution is reconciled, never reported as a known failure.
Run + message + execution commit before model or tool I/O.
Schedule deletion removes Run and public run history.
Deletion does not cancel accepted Sessions.
Session deletion keeps the original Run admission receipt.
No separate cron module or second legacy scheduler.
Thin admission never depends on Dispatcher or Runtime Registry.
Internal in-flight coordination remains only until safe cleanup.
